title: mansio Go platform (main 6330c9f; S3 work paused)

elements.name: Application developer / caller
elements.description: Writes and calls TypeScript handlers in the caller application.

elements.name: Platform operator
elements.description: Runs lifecycle commands, including move, attest-dead and restore; inspects offline logs.

elements.name: mansio Go platform
elements.description: Go-only document database platform; a database is the isolation and placement unit, and a tenant may own many databases.

elements.name: Caller application
elements.description: User application outside the server boundary; hosts the TypeScript SDK and application handlers.

elements.name: Caller process + SDK
elements.description: Application handlers and the TypeScript SDK run together here, outside the Go server.

elements.name: TypeScript SDK
elements.description: Records reads, buffers writes and derives asserts. Re-runs handlers on eligible conflicts; find reads are unguarded in v1.

elements.name: S3 — built, paused
elements.description: Implemented immutable SQLite generations and manifests. Work paused 2026-11-06 pending LiteFS; crash recovery can lose acknowledged writes.

elements.name: controld
elements.description: Control daemon: database lifecycle, routing, epoch authority access and signed-ticket issuing.

elements.name: edge / TLS proxy
elements.description: Separate stateless proxy; verifies tickets and routes by VM to private agentd. No compiler or database engine.

elements.name: agentd / Go server
elements.description: Per-VM daemon and database server in one process: ticket admission, actors, local files and lifecycle RPC.

elements.name: SQLite files
elements.description: One file per database; many databases per tenant. Local WAL and request-id records; database is the isolation unit.

elements.name: Placement registry
elements.description: Postgres placement and tenancy registry; CAS enforces epoch invariants. Local/test setups also have a file authority.

elements.name: Canonical JSONL
elements.description: Canonical persisted events. Bounded logging reports drops; canonical does not mean lossless.

elements.name: Offline log CLI
elements.description: scripts/logs.ts invokes TypeScript ingest, retention and named analysis queries outside agentd.

elements.name: Derived DuckDB copy
elements.description: Offline analysis rebuilt from retained JSONL. Not application query storage.

elements.name: Ticket admission
elements.description: Verifies signed claims offline and checks VM, database, permission and locally ACTIVE epoch.

elements.name: IR executor
elements.description: Validates document IR, dispatches actor closures and checks fingerprint and preconditions. Never runs application TypeScript.

elements.name: Document → SQL compiler
elements.description: Compiles document reads and writes to parameterized SQLite SQL inside execution.

elements.name: Bounded mailbox
elements.description: Nonblocking enqueue per database; full queues shed work and expired queued work does not run.

elements.name: Database actor
elements.description: One goroutine per database; runs closures on its connection. Optional read pool provides concurrent read snapshots.

elements.name: Group commit
elements.description: One write connection per actor. Batch transaction, individual write savepoints; replies follow commit.

elements.name: Request-id registry
elements.description: Claims _mansio_requests inside the write savepoint. Commits result with mutation; retained duplicates replay without reapplying.

elements.name: Write-back — paused
elements.description: Implemented snapshots, restore and epoch-stamped manifests. S3 work paused 2026-11-06 pending LiteFS; no WAL shipping.

elements.name: Structured event sink
elements.description: Nonblocking bounded queue and writer goroutine; flushes rolled JSONL, counts drops.

elements.name: Locator
elements.description: Authenticates API key; returns endpoint, epoch, generation and signed ticket. Refreshes stale placement from primary.

elements.name: Epoch authority
elements.description: Linearizable placement Get/CAS through Postgres. Owner changes require a higher epoch.

elements.name: Ticket signer
elements.description: Signs tenant, database, VM, epoch, principal, permissions and expiry with Ed25519.

elements.name: Lifecycle controller
elements.description: Moves, suspends and restores databases. Records operator attest-dead decisions; target agents restore published generations.

elements.name: Source agentd
elements.description: Source VM role of agentd: stop admission, drain, final write-back and durable FENCED before Ack.

elements.name: Target agentd
elements.description: Target VM role of agentd: verify authority, fetch generation and stamp new epoch before admission.

children.label: 1. Request move from source VM to target VM
2. CAS ACTIVE(source,E) to MOVING(source,E)
3. Stop admission and drain source work
4. Final write-back: immutable G and manifest at E; built, paused
5. Persist FENCED, acknowledge epoch E and generation G
6. With valid Ack, CAS to ACTIVE(target,E+1,G)
7. Ask target to claim database
8. Verify authority names target at E+1
9. Fetch G and stamp storage E+1 before admission; built, paused
10. Persist local ACTIVE at E+1 and acknowledge claim
11. Report completed move

documents.title: mansio Go platform: context
documents.plain: The caller runs application handlers. mansio runs Go IR execution. Operators manage lifecycle and offline analysis. S3 integration is implemented but paused by Nick on 2026-11-06 pending a LiteFS decision. Existing status denotes code at the pin, not live deployment.

ste.text: The caller runs application handlers. mansio runs Go IR execution. Operators manage lifecycle and offline analysis. S3 integration is implemented but paused by Nick on 2026-11-06 pending a LiteFS decision. Existing status denotes code at the pin, not live deployment.

documents.title: Request path: caller → control plane once → data plane
documents.plain: The TypeScript SDK is a library inside the caller process. Resolve returns a route and signed ticket. Reuse the cached route until refresh or invalidation; controld is not a per-query hop. The returned endpoint may be the edge, which forwards directly to agentd. agentd is both the VM daemon and Go server. Each tenant can own many databases. S3 storage is built but paused.

ste.text: The TypeScript SDK is a library inside the caller process. Resolve returns a route and signed ticket. Reuse the cached route until refresh or invalidation; controld is not a per-query hop. The returned endpoint may be the edge, which forwards directly to agentd. agentd is both the VM daemon and Go server. Each tenant can own many databases. S3 storage is built but paused.

documents.title: Caller process: in-process SDK and handler retries
documents.plain: The SDK records handler reads and buffered writes in the caller process. It derives preconditions and sends IR. Eligible conflicts re-run the handler in this same process. Route and signed-ticket caching avoid a control-plane lookup for every query.

ste.text: The SDK records handler reads and buffered writes in the caller process. It derives preconditions and sends IR. Eligible conflicts re-run the handler in this same process. Route and signed-ticket caching avoid a control-plane lookup for every query.

documents.title: agentd: admission, IR and per-database execution
documents.plain: Admission verifies the ticket and local epoch. The IR adapter queues a closure; an actor executes it, checking preconditions and compiling SQL. Each database has a bounded mailbox, goroutine and write connection. Writes share a batch transaction but have individual savepoints. Request-id claim, mutation and recorded result commit together; retained duplicate results replay. Reads run in a snapshot, optionally on a read pool. A conflict can cause the SDK to re-run a handler; no application handler runs here.

ste.text: Admission verifies the ticket and local epoch. The IR adapter queues a closure; an actor executes it, checking preconditions and compiling SQL. Each database has a bounded mailbox, goroutine and write connection. Writes share a batch transaction but have individual savepoints. Request-id claim, mutation and recorded result commit together; retained duplicate results replay. Reads run in a snapshot, optionally on a read pool. A conflict can cause the SDK to re-run a handler; no application handler runs here.

documents.title: agentd: paused durability and canonical events
documents.plain: The event sink writes canonical JSONL through a bounded queue; drops are counted, so canonical does not mean lossless. The separate durable host snapshots SQLite and publishes immutable generations. S3 work is IMPLEMENTED BUT PAUSED, not proposed. Default periodic backup is 10 seconds plus scheduling and upload time; acknowledged writes may be lost on crash. Version reuse after rollback is an open issue. WAL shipping and LiteFS replacement are not built.

ste.text: The event sink writes canonical JSONL through a bounded queue; drops are counted, so canonical does not mean lossless. The separate durable host snapshots SQLite and publishes immutable generations. S3 work is IMPLEMENTED BUT PAUSED, not proposed. Default periodic backup is 10 seconds plus scheduling and upload time; acknowledged writes may be lost on crash. Version reuse after rollback is an open issue. WAL shipping and LiteFS replacement are not built.

documents.title: controld: locator, signer and epoch authority
documents.plain: The locator authenticates an API key, reads placement and signs a ticket. The authority adapter uses Postgres CAS. The lifecycle controller moves databases and records operator attest-dead decisions; restore then asks live target agents to claim last published generations. Attest-dead belongs to controld, not to the edge or agentd. Durable restore depends on the implemented but paused S3 path.

documents.title: Canonical JSONL → offline DuckDB analysis
documents.plain: agentd writes JSONL; the offline TypeScript CLI ingests it into DuckDB and runs analysis. DuckDB is a derived copy rebuilt from retained input, not the canonical record or a Go-server dependency. Retention can remove source files; compressed retained files need decompression for a complete rebuild. Operator lifecycle tooling addresses controld separately.

documents.title: Query: resolve once, then cached-ticket data path
documents.plain: This successful first-query scenario resolves once. Subsequent calls reuse the cached ticket, subject to TTL refresh or stale-owner invalidation. The edge is a direct data-plane proxy, not another call through controld. Ticket validation occurs again in agentd. Compilation and SQLite execution run within the actor closure. Return steps are numbered explicitly.

documents.title: Database move: fence before epoch flip (S3 built, paused)
documents.plain: Successful graceful move in the implemented durable mode; S3 work is paused. Source and target boxes are two runtime roles of the same agentd executable, not different services. The source stops admission, drains admitted work, performs final write-back and durably records FENCED before acknowledgment. Only then may the authority flip to target at E+1. Claim checks authority, fetches G, stamps storage and persists ACTIVE before serving. A failed step leaves the move resumable; no unconditional flip after an unacknowledged fence. Attest-dead restore is a different path with an accepted loss window.

Claim checks authority, fetches G, stamps storage and persists ACTIVE before serving. A failed step leaves the move resumable; no unconditional flip after an unacknowledged fence. Attest-dead restore is a different path with an accepted loss window.
